{{Top|leg}}
'''Catalog Nineteen''' was a catalog of rare items collected by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] since the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Aside from [[Tatooine flamegem]]s, a sphere of pure [[Orichalc/Legends|orichalc]] and a container filled with extremely rare [[solarbenite]], the catalog contained a [[SD41263.I|Sith holocron]], which was stolen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal aide, [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]].
